capabilities: Copy absolute paths of multi-selected files and folders
Add a Copy absolute paths command to the File Explorer context menu
Trigger copying with a configurable hotkey
disambiguation: It copies file paths only; it does not copy note content or move or rename files.
extras: Desktop only (uses FileSystemAdapter.getFullPath); default hotkeys are Command-Option-C on macOS and Ctrl-Alt-C on Windows/Linux.
intentEvidence: This plugin adds Copy absolute paths to that menu and to the single-file menu.
problem: The stock multi-select context menu in File Explorer only offers move, bookmark, and delete, with no way to copy the selected items' absolute paths.
summary: File Explorer utility that copies the absolute filesystem paths of one or more selected files or folders via a context-menu command or hotkey.
